title: Support Ticket runtime and OpenAPI operation completeness

phases.objective: Compose every exact Support Ticket and Tenant Request runtime operation into the reviewed root OpenAPI contract with fail-closed authentication, path, operation identifier, response, and consequential metadata.

e2e_journeys.actor: OpenAPI maintenance runner and authenticated Support Ticket clients
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The precise contract registry sync reads routes/supportTicketRoutes.js before the missing-route coverage gate.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Every unique runtime method and normalized path is either bound to an existing reviewed path-item reference or represented by a deterministic source-bound OpenAPI operation, while ambiguous authorization and partial path coverage fail closed.
steps: Extract every literal Express method and path from the Support Ticket route source.
Normalize Express path parameters to OpenAPI path parameters and deduplicate exact signatures.
Bind requireUserJwt and requireTenantUserJwt routes to userJwtAuth.
Bind adminGuards routes to alternative adminBearerAuth or backendApiKeyAuth requirements.
Preserve existing precise path-item references and reject partial static path registration.
Generate deterministic operation identifiers, summaries, parameters, responses, and consequential flags for uncovered operations.
Run the governed generated-artifact writer on the exact non-protected branch head to update the root OpenAPI contract and the two bounded frontend/runtime-route indexes.
Re-run the same synchronization in check mode and require zero missing paths, conflicts, or drift.
assertions: Every current Support Ticket runtime operation has an exact OpenAPI method and normalized path.
Administrative operations declare adminBearerAuth and backendApiKeyAuth as alternatives.
Tenant and member operations declare userJwtAuth.
GET operations are non-consequential and mutation operations are consequential.
Every path parameter is required and typed as a non-empty string.
Operation identifiers are deterministic and collision-free.
The governed writer changes only openapi.yaml, frontend-surface-dispatch.generated.json, and openapi/frontend-runtime-routes.generated.yaml beyond reviewed source and test files.
An unknown or ambiguous runtime guard blocks synchronization.
A partially registered path blocks synchronization rather than overwriting reviewed contracts.
No runtime authorization, handler behavior, migration, SQL, deployment, provider, credential, external-send, protected-branch, or Production behavior changes.

phases.objective: Observe the governed generated-artifact writer refresh the exact OpenAPI and downstream indexes on a reviewed gpt branch without source-file mutation.
Exercise duplicate signatures, operation identifier collisions, unknown guards, partial static path registration, and authentication drift with stable blocking findings.
This contract-generation repair performs no live provider or deployment canary.
This repair grants no migration, SQL, deployment, Production, provider, credential, external publication, or direct protected-branch authority.
